rows.grounds: states the measure of the half-moon

items.question: How are the half-measure bindu and the obstructing power defined in this cosmology?
premises: The bindu is remembered as half-measure and has the form of space.
This bindu has four parts.
The half-moon is half of that bindu, and the obstructing power is an eighth part of it.
items.inference: The text defines a descending sequence of subtle levels from the half-measure bindu to the obstructing power by form and proportion.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'its' in the proportional compound is compressed and could be read in more than one way.
items.plain_english: The bindu is called the half-measure and is said to have the form of space with four parts. Half of that is the half-moon, and by an eighth part of it comes the obstructing power.

items.question: What must be done with the obstructing power to reach the supreme Sadakhya world?
premises: The obstructing power blocks the causes beginning with Brahma.
That obstructing power should then be abandoned.
After piercing this obstructing power, one reaches the supreme world called Sadakhya.
items.inference: Transcending the obstructing power is the condition for ascending to the supreme Sadakhya world.
uncertainties: The subject of 'should abandon' and 'having pierced' is implicit rather than stated.
items.plain_english: The obstructing power blocks the causes beginning with Brahma. One should abandon it, and after piercing through it, one reaches the supreme world called Sadakhya.

items.question: Who abides in the supreme Sadakhya world and what level follows above the bindu sequence?
premises: In that world abides one whose great body consists of the five mantras.
That presence is in a supreme form.
Above the bindu sequence ending with half-moon and obstruction comes the great Nada.
items.inference: Sadakhya is the abode of the five-mantra supreme form, and beyond the bindu sequence the great Nada appears.
uncertainties: The compound in the last token is dense, so the exact boundaries of the summarized sequence are interpretive.
items.plain_english: There abides, in supreme form, the one whose great body is made of the five mantras. Thus, above the bindu sequence that extends through the half-moon and the obstructing level, comes the great Nada.

items.question: What is the form of Nada and how are its worlds arranged?
premises: Nada resembles filaments and is surrounded by great beings.
There are four worlds in the directions.
There is a fifth world in the middle.
items.inference: Nada is a populated level with a fivefold world arrangement: four directional and one central.
items.plain_english: Nada resembles filaments and is surrounded by great beings. In that level there are four worlds in the directions and a fifth in the middle.

items.question: Which powers are present in Nada and what occupies its center?
premises: The powers named Kindling, Illuminating, Obstructing, Releasing, and Upward-going are present.
In the middle there is a lotus.
There an upward-going presence is surrounded by those powers.
items.inference: Nada's center contains a lotus with an upward-going presence attended by five named powers.
uncertainties: The identity of the upward-going presence is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: The powers Kindling, Illuminating, Obstructing, Releasing, and Upward-going are there. In the middle is a lotus, and there an upward-going presence is surrounded by those powers.

rows.grounds: identifies the ruler of that level
names the surrounding channels or powers

items.question: What level lies above Nada and how is its lord situated?
premises: Above Nada is the Sushumna level.
There the lord bearing its power presides.
That lord is surrounded on the left and right by Pingala and Ida.
items.inference: The Sushumna level above Nada is ruled by a lord flanked by Pingala and Ida.
uncertainties: Whether Pingala and Ida are meant as channels, powers, or both is not specified here.
items.plain_english: Above Nada is the Sushumna level. There presides its lord, bearing its power, surrounded on the left and right by Pingala and Ida.

rows.grounds: describes the extent of the path

items.question: Who is the goddess Sushumna and what is her role in the cosmic path?
premises: The goddess Sushumna sits in the lord's lap and has moonlike radiance.
By her the whole path is strung together.
That path extends both above and below.
items.inference: Sushumna is the radiant goddess who links the entire cosmic path vertically.
items.plain_english: The goddess Sushumna, who rests in the lord's lap and shines like the moon, strings together the whole path, both above and below.

items.question: How does the support of Nada and Sushumna pervade and move through the world?
premises: The support of Nada and Sushumna pierces this whole world.
It goes out below by the downward power.
It goes out above from the head by the upward power.
items.inference: The support of Nada and Sushumna pervades the entire world and moves in both downward and upward directions.
uncertainties: The verse uses an optative form, which may be descriptive or may carry an instructional nuance.
items.plain_english: The support of Nada and Sushumna pierces this whole world. By the downward power it goes out below, and by the upward power it goes out above from the head.

items.question: What is the nature of the unmanifest sound absorbed in the Brahma opening?
premises: An unmanifest, syllableless sound is absorbed in the channel at the Brahma opening.
That sound resounds in all beings.
It is presided over by Shiva's power.
items.inference: The syllableless unmanifest sound is both inwardly absorbed and universally pervasive through Shiva's power.
uncertainties: The first token's case relation is slightly compressed in the compound context.
items.plain_english: In the channel, at the Brahma opening, that unmanifest syllableless sound is absorbed. Yet it resounds in all beings, upheld by the power of Shiva.

items.question: What covering lies above Sushumna and who is present there?
premises: Above Sushumna there is a covering known as the Brahma opening.
There is present a deity named Brahma.
That deity is white, three-eyed, trident-bearing, five-faced, and moon-crested.
items.inference: The Brahma-opening covering above Sushumna is presided over by a Brahma figure with Shaiva attributes.
uncertainties: The deity is called Brahma but bears attributes often associated with Shiva, which may reflect a specific tantric identification.
items.plain_english: Above Sushumna is a covering known as the Brahma opening. There is Brahma, white in color, three-eyed, bearing a trident, five-faced, and crowned with the moon.

items.question: Who is the goddess in Brahma's lap and what lies beyond her?
premises: In Brahma's lap sits the supreme goddess Brahmani, who moves on the path of liberation.
She both obstructs and grants liberation.
After piercing her, one reaches the upward Kundalini.
items.inference: Brahmani governs access to liberation, and beyond her lies the upward Kundalini.
uncertainties: The sense in which she both obstructs and grants liberation is stated but not explained in this verse.
items.plain_english: In his lap sits the supreme goddess Brahmani, who moves on the path of liberation. She both obstructs and grants liberation. Having pierced through her, one comes to the upward Kundalini.

rows.grounds: name or description of her role
name of a power within her
name of a power within her

items.question: How is Kundalini described and what further powers are said to reside within her?
premises: The power called Kundalini resembles a sleeping snake.
She is called the support of the universe.
Within her are the Subtle, the Very Subtle, and likewise others such as the Immortal and the Measureless.
items.inference: Kundalini is the universal support and contains further increasingly subtle powers within herself.
uncertainties: The final two terms may be names of powers or descriptive epithets; the verse does not make this fully explicit.
items.plain_english: That power, resembling a sleeping snake, is called the support of the universe. Within her are the Subtle, the Very Subtle, and likewise others, the Immortal and the Measureless.
